title: EnvScaler: Scaling Tool-Interactive Environments for LLM Agent via Programmatic Synthesis
authors_zh: Xiaoshuai Song, Haofei Chang, Guanting Dong, Yutao Zhu, Zhicheng Dou, Ji-Rong Wen
paper_type_zh: 合成工具交互环境、训练轨迹与终态 verifier 发布
best_for_zh: 研究 agent SFT、RLVR、可执行环境扩展、终态判分与数据发布审计的读者
one_line: EnvScaler releases 191 executable tool environments, 7,234 SFT/RL scenarios, and 9,022 SFT trajectories, but SFT success is not terminal-state verified and reproducible RL reuse still lacks rollout, version, and verifier-audit records.
EnvScaler 发布 191 个可执行工具环境、7,234 条 SFT/RL scenario 和 9,022 条 SFT trajectory，并以终态 Python check 支持 RLVR；但 RL rollout 未发布、SFT 不做终态正确性验证，默认 HF loader、代码隔离和版本回放仍有缺口。
why: It makes environment scale a concrete post-training data variable—state, tools, rules, tasks, trajectories, and executable outcome checks—while showing why release shape, terminal-versus-success semantics, rejected samples, code safety, and version pins determine whether synthetic agent data can be trusted or replayed.
inclusion_reason: EnvScaler is a direct environment-and-agent-data contribution: it publishes executable stateful tool worlds, distinct SFT and verifier-bearing RL scenarios, and filtered SFT trajectories while exposing how generated terminal checks and environment scale enter agent post-training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The authoritative paper record is arXiv:2601.05808v2, revised on 2026-04-17; no formal conference or journal venue is verified, so the venue remains arXiv preprint. The evidence freeze also covers the official RUC-NLPIR/EnvScaler repository at commit 87e667397abacf274858c0964796beb8f984aafe and four official Hugging Face dataset revisions. EnvScaler addresses a concrete bottleneck in agent post-training: executable, stateful tool environments and outcome checks are expensive to author, so environment variety can lag behind model and rollout scale.

The paper turns environment scale into a data-construction variable. Starting from stateful, domain-specific API-Bank and ToolACE tasks, the pipeline induces environment descriptions, removes near-duplicates, generates executable Python worlds, checks them repeatedly, synthesizes initialized scenarios and terminal-state check functions, and then collects SFT trajectories or performs online RL. The resulting object is not one monolithic “agent dataset”; it is a linked bundle of environment code, scenarios, trajectories, and feedback programs.

The verified public bundle has four distinct objects: 191 executable environment rows; 4,684 SFT scenario rows across 140 environments without check functions; 2,550 RL scenario rows with executable checklist functions; and 9,022 claimed SFT trajectories generated by Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507. The 4,684 and 2,550 scenario releases total 7,234. Runtime code can serialize richer episodes with observations, actions, rewards, termination and truncation, but no RL rollout corpus or complete paper-run replay archive is released.

This Card belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because environment state, tool schema, agent action, observation, terminal check, scalar reward, and trajectory are all material to the training interface. Evidence supports SFT, RLVR-style outcome training, and agent training; it does not support preference learning, reward-model training, process supervision, or use of EnvScaler as an evaluation dataset. The accepted metadata remains partial and L3_summary_ready. The bilingual text reaches L4 reading depth without upgrading that workflow state, and preserves the loader, replay, verifier, security, rights, and version gaps.

权威论文记录是 2026 年 4 月 17 日修订的 arXiv:2601.05808v2；没有核验到正式会议或期刊 venue，因此仍记为 arXiv preprint。证据冻结还覆盖官方 RUC-NLPIR/EnvScaler repository 的 commit 87e667397abacf274858c0964796beb8f984aafe，以及四个官方 Hugging Face dataset revision。EnvScaler 处理的具体瓶颈是：可执行、有状态的工具环境和 outcome check 编写成本高，导致 agent post-training 中的环境多样性可能落后于模型和 rollout 规模。

论文把 environment scale 变成数据构造变量。pipeline 从 API-Bank 与 ToolACE 中有状态、领域特定的任务开始，归纳环境描述、去除近重复、生成 executable Python world、反复检查、合成带初始化状态的 scenario 与 terminal-state check function，随后收集 SFT trajectory 或开展 online RL。因此，最终对象不是单一的“agent dataset”，而是 environment code、scenario、trajectory 与 feedback program 相互关联的 bundle。

已核验公开 bundle 包含四种不同对象：191 条 executable environment row；跨 140 个环境、没有 check function 的 4,684 条 SFT scenario；带 executable checklist function 的 2,550 条 RL scenario；以及由 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 生成、声称共 9,022 条的 SFT trajectory。4,684 与 2,550 两个 scenario 发布合计 7,234 条。runtime code 可以序列化包含 observation、action、reward、termination 与 truncation 的更丰富 episode，但没有发布 RL rollout corpus 或完整 paper-run replay archive。

本 Card 归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为 environment state、tool schema、agent action、observation、terminal check、scalar reward 和 trajectory 都是训练接口的重要组成。证据支持 SFT、RLVR-style outcome training 与 agent training；不支持 preference learning、reward-model training、process supervision，也不支持把 EnvScaler 当作 evaluation dataset。accepted metadata 仍为 partial 和 L3_summary_ready。双语正文达到 L4 阅读深度，但不提升 workflow state，并保留 loader、replay、verifier、security、rights 与 version 缺口。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
EnvScaler’s central move is to scale the executable environment before scaling interaction data. SkelBuilder derives candidate worlds from a filtered task pool, generates state schemas, constraint rules, operations, class code, and documentation, and keeps candidates that survive repeated LLM-agent checking. ScenGenerator then attaches initial state, a task, checklist text, and—in the RL release—Boolean Python check functions. This separates what the agent may do from how final success is measured.

A released environment row contains env_id, summary/introduction, state-space definition, constraint rules, operation and tool schemas, environment class name, executable code and definition, and function details. Across the 191 retained environments, Paper Table 2 reports averages of 4.58 constraint rules, 21.38 state categories, and 18.58 tools. SFT and RL scenarios share environment/task IDs, class name, JSON-serialized initial configuration, and task text; only RL scenarios publicly include checklist_with_func.

The released SFT trajectory record is a conversation or non-conversation transcript containing task_info, serialized tool definitions, system/user/assistant/tool messages and tool calls, simulated-user messages where applicable, and step count. This is genuine published trajectory data. It must not be conflated with the paper’s online RL rollouts: the official collection contains no RL rollout dataset, reward-trace archive, full final-state log, or successful/failed rollout corpus.

The feedback contract is mixed. At RL runtime, each generated check function evaluates a Boolean condition on final environment state, and reward is the fraction of checks passed, producing a scalar in [0,1]. Yet the environments and checks were generated and selected with LLM agents, and raw pass/warning/fail votes, rejected checks, and independent false-positive/false-negative audits are absent. Programmatic execution at use time therefore does not make the end-to-end contract purely programmatic.

Termination is also separate from success. Non-conversation episodes end when the model emits Task Completed or reaches an action limit; conversation episodes end when the simulated user emits ###STOP### or the action limit is reached. Only verifier-bearing RL scenarios compute terminal-state checklist reward. SFT environments intentionally return zero reward and omit check functions, so a clean completion marker is not proof that a released SFT trajectory solved its task.

The closest Atlas comparisons named in the accepted metadata are Feedback-Driven Tool-Use Improvements via Automated Build Environments, EnvFactory, and ScaleEnv. EnvScaler’s verified direction signal is the explicit four-object release and its split between SFT transcript construction and verifier-bearing RL scenarios. This Card does not infer comparative advantages beyond the evidence ledger.

EnvScaler 的核心变化是在扩展交互数据之前先扩展可执行环境。SkelBuilder 从筛选后的任务池归纳候选 world，生成 state schema、constraint rule、operation、class code 与 documentation，并保留能通过反复 LLM-agent 检查的候选环境。ScenGenerator 再加入 initial state、task、checklist text，以及只在 RL 发布中出现的 Boolean Python check function。这样便把“agent 可以做什么”与“如何判断最终成功”分离开来。

一条公开 environment row 包含 env_id、summary/introduction、state-space definition、constraint rule、operation/tool schema、environment class name、executable code/definition 与 function detail。对 191 个保留环境，论文 Table 2 报告平均每个环境有 4.58 条 constraint rule、21.38 个 state category 和 18.58 个 tool。SFT 与 RL scenario 都含 environment/task ID、class name、JSON-serialized initial configuration 和 task text；只有 RL scenario 公开包含 checklist_with_func。

公开 SFT trajectory record 是 conversation 或 non-conversation transcript，包含 task_info、序列化 tool definition、system/user/assistant/tool message 与 tool call、适用时的 simulated-user message，以及 step count。这确实是已发布 trajectory data，但不能与论文的 online RL rollout 混为一谈：官方 collection 没有 RL rollout dataset、reward-trace archive、完整 final-state log 或成功/失败 rollout corpus。

feedback contract 是 mixed。RL runtime 中，每个生成的 check function 对最终 environment state 判断一个 Boolean condition，reward 是通过 check 的比例，因此形成 [0,1] scalar。但 environment 与 check 本身由 LLM agent 生成和筛选，raw pass/warning/fail vote、rejected check 以及独立 false-positive/false-negative audit 都缺失。所以，使用时可程序执行并不意味着端到端契约是纯 programmatic。

termination 也不同于 success。non-conversation episode 在模型输出 Task Completed 或达到 action limit 时结束；conversation episode 在 simulated user 输出 ###STOP### 或达到 action limit 时结束。只有带 verifier 的 RL scenario 会计算 terminal-state checklist reward。SFT environment 有意返回 zero reward 且省略 check function，因此干净的 completion marker 不能证明某条公开 SFT trajectory 已正确完成任务。

accepted metadata 指出的 Atlas 近邻包括 Feedback-Driven Tool-Use Improvements via Automated Build Environments、EnvFactory 与 ScaleEnv。EnvScaler 已核验的方向信号是清晰的四对象发布，以及 SFT transcript construction 与 verifier-bearing RL scenario 之间的分工。本 Card 不在 evidence ledger 之外推断比较优势。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and discovery. The source pool is API-Bank and ToolACE. Tasks are filtered for stateful, domain-specific tool interaction, transformed by LLMs into environment descriptions, embedded, and deduplicated. GPT-4.1 and Qwen3-235B-Instruct-2507 support discovery and programming; GPT-4.1-mini and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 support checking and assessment. Per-record upstream IDs, source-mixture weights, complete transformation prompts, model endpoint dates, decoding settings, and retry policy are not released.

Environment synthesis and selection. SkelBuilder produces Python state, constraints, operations/tools, class code, definitions, and documentation. The paper reports 266 synthesized candidates. Each receives 100 checking rounds, and the released selector keeps an environment when not_fail_num / total_num is at least 0.85. The numerator combines pass and warning, so 0.85 is a pass-or-warning threshold, not a strict 85% correctness rate. The process retains 191 environments and rejects 75, or 28.2%; the rejected programs and complete check-agent records are unavailable.

Scenario construction. ScenGenerator synthesizes initial configuration, task text, checklist items, and executable Python Boolean check functions. The SFT branch selects 140 environments and releases 4,684 task/configuration rows with the check functions intentionally omitted. The RL branch uses the remaining 51 environments and releases 2,550 task/configuration rows with checklist_with_func. The split seed, selection policy beyond the 140/51 counts, semantic overlap, and decontamination analysis are unknown.

SFT interaction and filtering. Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 generates both conversation and non-conversation trajectories. The public filtering path rejects invalid syntax, incomplete episodes, LLM-judged-impossible tasks, and trajectories outside 3–29 actions for non-conversation or 5–39 for conversation. Non-conversation retention requires Task Completed; conversation retention requires user ###STOP###. Roughly 9K remain, and the pinned dataset claims 9,022 trajectories. Because SFT scenarios omit checks and the SFT environment returns zero reward, this is format/completion/action-count filtering rather than terminal-state success verification.

SFT optimization. The paper and configuration use full-parameter LlamaFactory SFT for three epochs at learning rate 1e-6, maximum length 32K, and effective batch size 256. Multi-round examples use mask_history so only the final-turn reasoning/action is supervised. The scaling study trains Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B variants; exact model-artifact revisions for every run are not bound in one manifest.

RL interaction and reward. RL uses non-conversation interaction, ROLL/Reinforce++, KL coefficient 0.1, 64 tasks with 8 rollouts each per update step, and up to roughly 200 steps. This implies 512 online rollouts per update step, not a released corpus. The paper sets maximum trajectory length to 32K and per-interaction generation length to 4K; the example configuration additionally uses seed 42, temperature 0.99, top-p 0.99, top-k 100, learning rate 1e-6, max_steps 201, and max_actions 40. Final reward is passed Boolean checks divided by total checks.

Runtime and safety. The interaction runner may preserve task information, tools, messages, user messages, per-step observations/actions/rewards, terminated/truncated flags, total reward, final observation/information, and step count. That schema is runtime capability, not evidence that RL episodes were released. Environment class strings and check-function strings execute through Python exec with builtins available. The code is not a security sandbox; any replay must isolate these artifacts as untrusted executable code.

Release reconstruction. The evidence freeze binds paper v2, code commit 87e6673, and four HF revisions: 191-Env 3d30c6a, SFT-Scenario bf3bf86, RL-Scenario a140615, and SFT-Traj-9K 0279d9a. No Git tag, GitHub Release, dependency lock, or immutable manifest binds all of them to prompts, model endpoints, and seeds. The SFT trajectory revision also mixes a raw trajectory file with a transformed instruction/input/output/system/history file. Their incompatible schemas make the default Hugging Face builder/viewer fail with DatasetGenerationCastError, although individual raw files remain downloadable.

输入与 discovery。source pool 来自 API-Bank 和 ToolACE。任务先按有状态、领域特定的工具交互筛选，再由 LLM 转换成环境描述，随后 embedding 与 deduplication。GPT-4.1 和 Qwen3-235B-Instruct-2507 支持 discovery/programming；GPT-4.1-mini 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 支持 checking/assessment。逐记录 upstream ID、source-mixture weight、完整 transformation prompt、model endpoint 日期、decoding setting 与 retry policy 均未发布。

环境合成与选择。SkelBuilder 生成 Python state、constraint、operation/tool、class code、definition 与 documentation。论文报告共合成 266 个 candidate。每个 candidate 接受 100 轮检查；发布 selector 在 not_fail_num / total_num 至少为 0.85 时保留环境。分子把 pass 与 warning 合并，因此 0.85 是 pass-or-warning threshold，不是严格 85% correctness rate。该过程保留 191 个环境并拒绝 75 个，即 28.2%；被拒 program 与完整 check-agent record 不可得。

scenario 构造。ScenGenerator 合成 initial configuration、task text、checklist item 和 executable Python Boolean check function。SFT 分支选择 140 个环境，发布 4,684 条 task/configuration row，并有意省略 check function。RL 分支使用其余 51 个环境，发布 2,550 条带 checklist_with_func 的 task/configuration row。split seed、除 140/51 数量之外的 selection policy、semantic overlap 与 decontamination analysis 均为 unknown。

SFT 交互与过滤。Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 生成 conversation 与 non-conversation trajectory。公开 filtering path 会拒绝 invalid syntax、incomplete episode、被 LLM 判断 impossible 的 task，以及 action 数不在 non-conversation 3–29 或 conversation 5–39 范围内的 trajectory。non-conversation 保留要求出现 Task Completed；conversation 保留要求 user 输出 ###STOP###。最终保留约 9K，固定 dataset 声称有 9,022 条 trajectory。由于 SFT scenario 省略 check、SFT environment 返回 zero reward，这属于 format/completion/action-count filtering，而不是 terminal-state success verification。

SFT optimization。论文与 configuration 使用 full-parameter LlamaFactory SFT，训练三个 epoch，learning rate 为 1e-6，maximum length 为 32K，effective batch size 为 256。多轮 example 使用 mask_history，只监督 final-turn reasoning/action。scaling study 训练 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B variant；每次 run 的确切 model-artifact revision 没有绑定在同一 manifest 中。

RL 交互与 reward。RL 使用 non-conversation interaction、ROLL/Reinforce++、KL coefficient 0.1，每个 update step 采样 64 个 task、每题 8 条 rollout，最多约 200 step。这意味着每个 update step 有 512 条 online rollout，而不是已发布 corpus。论文设置 maximum trajectory length 32K、每次 interaction generation length 4K；example configuration 还使用 seed 42、temperature 0.99、top-p 0.99、top-k 100、learning rate 1e-6、max_steps 201 和 max_actions 40。最终 reward 是通过 Boolean check 数除以 check 总数。

runtime 与 safety。interaction runner 可以保留 task information、tool、message、user message、逐步 observation/action/reward、terminated/truncated flag、total reward、final observation/information 和 step count。该 schema 是 runtime capability，不是 RL episode 已发布的证据。environment class string 与 check-function string 通过开放 builtins 的 Python exec 执行。该代码不是 security sandbox；任何 replay 都必须把这些 artifact 当作不受信任的 executable code 进行隔离。

发布重建。证据冻结绑定 paper v2、code commit 87e6673，以及四个 HF revision：191-Env 3d30c6a、SFT-Scenario bf3bf86、RL-Scenario a140615、SFT-Traj-9K 0279d9a。没有 Git tag、GitHub Release、dependency lock 或 immutable manifest 把它们与 prompt、model endpoint 和 seed 统一绑定。SFT trajectory revision 还混合一个 raw trajectory file 与一个转换后的 instruction/input/output/system/history file；schema 不兼容导致默认 Hugging Face builder/viewer 以 DatasetGenerationCastError 失败，但单独 raw file 仍可下载。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is conditional on the released training recipe and the three evaluated Qwen3 scales. Paper Table 4 reports that SFT improves average scores by +8.67 on BFCL-v3 multi-turn, +4.29 on Tau-Bench, and +11.57 on ACEBench-Agent. For Qwen3-8B, subsequent RL adds +4.88 on BFCL and +3.46 on Tau-Bench. These are author-reported benchmark deltas under the paper’s configurations; the Card did not independently rerun training or evaluation.

The negative result matters: RL does not improve every model and benchmark combination. Qwen3-1.7B slightly declines on Tau-Bench after RL, which the authors attribute to a smaller model’s sensitivity to noisy reward. This bounds any claim that more generated environments or programmatic outcome checks automatically produce monotonic gains.

The construction evidence includes both scale and rejection. Of 266 synthesized environment candidates, 191 survive the 100-round not-fail selection and 75 are rejected, a 28.2% rejection rate. The paper identifies type/attribute errors and state-management inconsistency as prominent failure classes. Table 2 reports 4.58 constraints, 21.38 state categories, and 18.58 tools per retained environment on average. However, because warning counts with pass in the at-least-0.85 selector, the retained count is not evidence that 85% of strict checks passed.

The release evidence was checked at the object level. The pinned official datasets expose 191 environment rows, 4,684 SFT scenarios, 2,550 RL scenarios, and a claimed 9,022 SFT trajectories. The SFT scenarios omit check functions; RL scenarios include executable checklist functions. The trajectory revision’s incompatible raw and masked schemas break the default Hugging Face loader/viewer, but the individual source files remain downloadable. There is no RL rollout dataset in the official collection.

The paper also asks Claude-4.5-Sonnet to score tool-program alignment, functional correctness, and robustness and reports averages above 8.5 with agreement to manual judgment. This is an author-run LLM assessment, not an independent semantic verifier audit. It does not establish check-function coverage, absence of false rewards, resistance to reward hacking, safe code execution, or replay equivalence across versions.

Taken together, the evidence supports the narrower claim that programmatically synthesized environments can supply useful SFT and outcome-reward training surfaces under the stated setup. It does not prove that every released SFT trajectory is terminally correct, that the generated verifier is unbiased, that RL rollouts are publicly reproducible, or that benchmark gains establish data quality or legal/safe reuse.

最强实验证据受已发布训练 recipe 和三个 Qwen3 规模的条件限制。论文 Table 4 报告，SFT 使 BFCL-v3 multi-turn、Tau-Bench 与 ACEBench-Agent 的平均分分别提升 +8.67、+4.29 和 +11.57。对 Qwen3-8B，后续 RL 在 BFCL 与 Tau-Bench 上又分别增加 +4.88 和 +3.46。这些是论文 configuration 下由作者报告的 benchmark delta；本 Card 没有独立重跑训练或评测。

负面结果同样重要：RL 并不改善所有模型与 benchmark 组合。Qwen3-1.7B 在 RL 后的 Tau-Bench 得分略微下降，作者把它归因于小模型对 noisy reward 更敏感。这限定了“更多生成环境或 programmatic outcome check 会自动带来单调增益”的说法。

构造证据同时包含规模与 rejection。266 个合成 environment candidate 中，191 个通过 100-round not-fail selection，75 个被拒，拒绝率为 28.2%。论文把 type/attribute error 与 state-management inconsistency 列为主要 failure class。Table 2 报告每个保留环境平均有 4.58 条 constraint、21.38 个 state category 与 18.58 个 tool。但由于至少 0.85 的 selector 把 warning 与 pass 合并，保留数量不能证明严格 check 的 85% 都通过。

release evidence 已在对象层核验。固定官方 dataset 暴露 191 条 environment row、4,684 条 SFT scenario、2,550 条 RL scenario，以及声称共 9,022 条的 SFT trajectory。SFT scenario 省略 check function，RL scenario 包含 executable checklist function。trajectory revision 中 raw 与 masked schema 不兼容，导致默认 Hugging Face loader/viewer 失败，但单独源文件仍可下载。官方 collection 没有 RL rollout dataset。

论文还让 Claude-4.5-Sonnet 对 tool-program alignment、functional correctness 与 robustness 打分，报告平均值高于 8.5，并称与人工判断一致。这是作者运行的 LLM assessment，不是独立 semantic verifier audit；它不能证明 check-function coverage、没有 false reward、抵抗 reward hacking、代码执行安全或跨版本 replay equivalence。

综合来看，证据支持一个较窄结论：在所述 setup 下，程序合成环境可以提供有用的 SFT 与 outcome-reward training surface。它不证明每条公开 SFT trajectory 都满足终态正确性、生成 verifier 无偏、RL rollout 可公开复现，也不证明 benchmark gain 等同于 data quality 或合法/安全复用。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work bottleneck, as framed by EnvScaler, is not merely too few prompts or too few rollouts but too few executable, diverse, stateful environments with verifiable outcomes. The paper changes the unit of scaling from an interaction transcript alone to a coupled environment bundle: state schema, constraints, tools, executable implementation, scenario initialization, task, check functions, and trajectories.

The most concrete mechanism change is the use of terminal-state Python checks rather than requiring one exact reference action sequence. A checklist can accept multiple action paths that reach the required final conditions, and its Boolean outputs aggregate into scalar reward. This is useful for RLVR-style agent training because the verifier attaches to outcome state, while state-action interaction remains available to the policy. The novelty does not remove verifier risk: a generated check can miss requirements, reject valid states, or reward a shortcut.

A second direction signal is the deliberate separation of SFT and RL objects. The SFT branch releases scenarios without checks and teacher transcripts filtered by syntax, completion, feasibility judgment, and length. The RL branch releases verifier-bearing scenarios and uses online model rollouts for optimization. The public release contains the former trajectories and the latter tasks/checkers, not the latter rollouts. That boundary is central to interpreting what can be reused.

A third contribution is environment-level filtering at scale. Candidates receive 100 rounds of LLM-agent assessment, and 191 of 266 are retained under a pass-or-warning threshold of at least 0.85. This is more specific than claiming that generated code was “validated,” because it exposes the selection statistic. At the same time, missing raw votes, warnings, rejected programs, and calibration prevent the threshold from serving as a complete quality guarantee.

The work does not invent Python tool execution, LLM code generation, simulated users, SFT, Reinforce++, scalar terminal reward, or benchmark evaluation. Much of the contribution is an integrated construction and scaling pipeline plus a multi-object release. The evidence also does not establish process supervision, a reward model, preference pairs, deterministic offline replay, or a public RL trajectory corpus.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is that environment diversity, executable feedback, release schema, and failure retention are part of the data recipe. Reuse checks must therefore cover not just transcript count but source lineage, check semantics, warning treatment, dropped failures, code sandboxing, loader compatibility, split/contamination, and a manifest binding paper, code, data, models, prompts, and dependencies.

按照 EnvScaler 的问题定义，既有瓶颈不只是 prompt 或 rollout 太少，而是带可验证 outcome 的可执行、多样、有状态环境太少。论文把 scaling unit 从单独 interaction transcript 改为耦合的 environment bundle：state schema、constraint、tool、executable implementation、scenario initialization、task、check function 与 trajectory。

最具体的机制变化是使用 terminal-state Python check，而不是要求唯一精确 reference action sequence。checklist 可以接受到达所需最终条件的多条 action path，Boolean output 再聚合为 scalar reward。这适合 RLVR-style agent training，因为 verifier 附着在 outcome state，而 policy 仍能观察 state-action interaction。该新意没有消除 verifier risk：生成 check 仍可能漏掉要求、拒绝有效 state，或奖励 shortcut。

第二个方向信号是有意分离 SFT 与 RL 对象。SFT 分支发布不带 check 的 scenario，以及按 syntax、completion、feasibility judgment 与 length 筛选的 teacher transcript；RL 分支发布带 verifier 的 scenario，并用 online model rollout 做 optimization。公开发布包含前者的 trajectory 和后者的 task/checker，却不包含后者 rollout。理解复用范围时，这一边界至关重要。

第三项贡献是规模化 environment-level filtering。candidate 接受 100 轮 LLM-agent assessment，266 个中有 191 个在至少 0.85 的 pass-or-warning threshold 下被保留。这比只说 generated code “经过验证”更具体，因为 selection statistic 是明确的。但 raw vote、warning、rejected program 与 calibration 缺失，使该 threshold 仍不能充当完整 quality guarantee。

论文并没有发明 Python tool execution、LLM code generation、simulated user、SFT、Reinforce++、scalar terminal reward 或 benchmark evaluation。贡献中有很大部分是 integrated construction/scaling pipeline 与 multi-object release。证据也没有证明 process supervision、reward model、preference pair、deterministic offline replay 或公开 RL trajectory corpus。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号是 environment diversity、executable feedback、release schema 和 failure retention 本身就是 data recipe 的组成。复用检查不能只看 transcript 数量，还必须覆盖 source lineage、check semantics、warning treatment、dropped failure、code sandboxing、loader compatibility、split/contamination，以及把 paper、code、data、model、prompt 与 dependency 绑定起来的 manifest。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• SFT success boundary: the 9,022 claimed released SFT trajectories are real transcripts, but SFT scenarios omit check functions and the public SFT environment returns zero reward. Retention verifies syntax, completion markers, length, and an LLM impossibility judgment—not terminal task success.
  • RL release boundary: verifier-bearing RL scenarios are public and the paper describes online RL episodes, yet no RL rollout corpus, per-step reward archive, complete final-state log, or success/failure accounting was found. The runtime schema must not be reported as released data.
  • Verifier coverage: generated Boolean checks may omit intended constraints, over-constrain valid solutions, depend on brittle state fields, or reward terminal-state shortcuts. This is a curator inference grounded in the generated-check contract; no independent false-positive/false-negative, coverage, reward-hacking, or adversarial audit is reported.
  • Selection semantics: environment acceptance combines warning with pass in a not-fail rate of at least 0.85. Raw votes, disagreement, calibration, rejected checks, and the 75 rejected environment programs/logs are missing, so strict correctness and selection bias cannot be reconstructed.
  • Termination versus correctness: Task Completed, ###STOP###, and action limits end episodes independently of checklist reward. A trajectory can terminate cleanly while incomplete or incorrect, and a generated check can be gamed without violating the stop rule.
  • Executable-code risk: environment classes and check strings run through Python exec with builtins available. The release is not sandboxed; malicious or defective generated code can affect files, processes, credentials, or network state unless replay is isolated. This is a code-safety boundary, not proof that the inspected release is malicious.
  • Loader defect: the pinned SFT trajectory revision mixes incompatible raw and instruction/input/output/system/history schemas, causing DatasetGenerationCastError in the default Hugging Face builder/viewer. Individual raw files remain accessible, but default loading is not a reproducible one-command path.
  • Version and replay: no tag, GitHub Release, dependency lock, or immutable manifest binds arXiv v2, commit 87e6673, four HF revisions, prompts, endpoints, seeds, and exact model artifacts. State diffs, dependency images, complete rewards, and paper-run replay fixtures are also missing.
  • Split, overlap, and contamination: the paper uses 140 environments for SFT and 51 for RL, then evaluates on BFCL-v3 multi-turn, Tau-Bench, and ACEBench-Agent. Split seed/policy, semantic deduplication, source/benchmark overlap, and pretraining or future-public-exposure audits are undisclosed.
  • Lineage and rights: repository and dataset cards state MIT, but per-row API-Bank/ToolACE provenance, upstream transformation rights, provider-output terms, prompts, generator/checker responses, and the scope of the root license over every object are not separately established.
  • Failure retention: malformed, incomplete, length-invalid, and LLM-judged-impossible SFT cases are dropped; 75 environments are rejected; RL rollouts are not published. Rejection counts by trajectory reason, discarded samples, raw checks, and successful/failed episode corpora are unavailable.
  • Generalization and simulator limits: authors note synthesis bias, limited open environments, and missing real latency, network, and error dynamics. The simulated-user model/version, prompts, decoding, retry behavior, and stop-policy details are incomplete. The Qwen3-1.7B Tau-Bench decline also shows that RL gains are not uniform.

• SFT success 边界：声称公开的 9,022 条 SFT trajectory 是真实 transcript，但 SFT scenario 省略 check function，public SFT environment 也返回 zero reward。保留标准核验的是 syntax、completion marker、length 与 LLM impossibility judgment，而不是 terminal task success。
  • RL 发布边界：带 verifier 的 RL scenario 已公开，论文也描述 online RL episode，但没有发现 RL rollout corpus、逐步 reward archive、完整 final-state log 或 success/failure accounting。runtime schema 不能被写成已发布数据。
  • verifier coverage：生成 Boolean check 可能遗漏预期 constraint、过度限制有效 solution、依赖脆弱 state field，或奖励 terminal-state shortcut。这是基于 generated-check contract 的 curator inference；论文没有报告独立 false-positive/false-negative、coverage、reward-hacking 或 adversarial audit。
  • selection semantics：environment acceptance 在至少 0.85 的 not-fail rate 中把 warning 与 pass 合并。raw vote、disagreement、calibration、rejected check 以及 75 个 rejected environment program/log 缺失，因此无法重建 strict correctness 与 selection bias。
  • termination 与 correctness：Task Completed、###STOP### 和 action limit 独立于 checklist reward 结束 episode。trajectory 可以在未完成或错误时干净终止，generated check 也可能在不违反 stop rule 的情况下被 gaming。
  • executable-code 风险：environment class 与 check string 通过开放 builtins 的 Python exec 运行。发布没有 sandbox；如果 replay 未隔离，恶意或有缺陷的生成代码可能影响文件、进程、credential 或 network state。这是 code-safety 边界，不是在断言已检查 release 具有恶意。
  • loader 缺陷：固定 SFT trajectory revision 混合不兼容的 raw 与 instruction/input/output/system/history schema，导致默认 Hugging Face builder/viewer 抛出 DatasetGenerationCastError。单独 raw file 仍可访问，但 default loading 不是可复现的一键路径。
  • 版本与 replay：没有 tag、GitHub Release、dependency lock 或 immutable manifest 绑定 arXiv v2、commit 87e6673、四个 HF revision、prompt、endpoint、seed 与确切 model artifact。state diff、dependency image、完整 reward 与 paper-run replay fixture 也缺失。
  • split、overlap 与 contamination：论文使用 140 个环境做 SFT、51 个做 RL，随后在 BFCL-v3 multi-turn、Tau-Bench 与 ACEBench-Agent 上评测。split seed/policy、semantic deduplication、source/benchmark overlap，以及 pretraining 或 future-public-exposure audit 均未披露。
  • lineage 与 rights：repository 与 dataset card 声明 MIT，但逐记录 API-Bank/ToolACE provenance、upstream transformation right、provider-output term、prompt、generator/checker response，以及 root license 对所有对象的覆盖范围没有单独确立。
  • failure retention：malformed、incomplete、length-invalid 与被 LLM 判断 impossible 的 SFT case 会被丢弃；75 个环境被拒；RL rollout 未发布。按 trajectory reason 的 rejection count、discarded sample、raw check 与成功/失败 episode corpus 均不可得。
  • 泛化与 simulator 限制：作者指出 synthesis bias、open environment 有限，以及缺少真实 latency、network 与 error dynamics。simulated-user model/version、prompt、decoding、retry behavior 与 stop-policy detail 不完整。Qwen3-1.7B 在 Tau-Bench 上下降也说明 RL gain 并不统一。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, EnvScaler is useful because it exposes several separable post-training objects rather than only a model checkpoint. Researchers can inspect environment state/rules/tools/code, SFT task initializations, verifier-bearing RL task initializations, and SFT message/tool-call transcripts. A good downstream inventory should preserve those object types separately and never infer RL trajectories from the runtime API.

Environment and scenario inspection is feasible with pinned revisions. An audit can statically analyze the 191 code objects, count tool and state-schema fields, map 4,684 SFT and 2,550 RL scenarios to env_id, verify that only the RL branch carries checklist_with_func, and test each check under isolated final-state mutations. Before execution, generated class/check strings should be sandboxed with file, process, credential, and network boundaries.

SFT reuse is possible only with caution. A user must explicitly select a compatible raw or transformed trajectory file because the default Hugging Face builder mixes incompatible schemas. They should reproduce the published format/completion/length filters, distinguish conversation from non-conversation stop rules, retain the teacher identity Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, and avoid labeling the rows terminally verified. Upstream rights, lineage, dropped failures, and data-specific license scope still need review.

RLVR research can start from the 2,550 verifier-bearing RL scenarios and the released runtime/training scaffold. Useful studies include property-based tests of each Python predicate, blinded human review of checklist coverage, alternate-valid-state tests, adversarial shortcut search, reward-hacking probes, warning-versus-pass sensitivity, and cross-version replay. This supports a research starting point, not drop-in reproduction of the paper’s RL run, because online rollouts, reward traces, exact endpoints, dependencies, and the run manifest are missing.

The construction recipe can be reused as a controlled ablation: hold task count fixed while varying environment count, or hold environments fixed while varying scenario and rollout count; compare strict-pass selection with pass-or-warning; release rejected programs and trajectories; and measure whether gains follow environment diversity, teacher behavior, verifier coverage, or data volume. The Qwen3-1.7B Tau-Bench decline should remain a required negative control.

Reuse class is mixed and conditional. Evidence supports the intended uses SFT, RLVR, and agent training, but the release is not yet verified safe or drop-in reproducible for unrestricted training. Environment/scenario inspection is usable at pinned revisions; SFT requires schema selection and rights/quality review; exact RL reproduction is blocked pending rollout/replay, verifier, security, dependency, and version evidence. Benchmark gains alone do not override those boundaries.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，EnvScaler 的价值在于暴露了多个可分离的 post-training object，而不只是一个 model checkpoint。研究者可以分别检查 environment state/rule/tool/code、SFT task initialization、带 verifier 的 RL task initialization，以及 SFT message/tool-call transcript。下游 inventory 应分别保留这些对象，绝不能从 runtime API 推断 RL trajectory 已发布。

固定 revision 后，可以检查 environment 与 scenario。审计可以静态分析 191 个 code object，统计 tool 与 state-schema field，把 4,684 条 SFT 和 2,550 条 RL scenario 映射到 env_id，核验只有 RL 分支携带 checklist_with_func，并在隔离环境中用 final-state mutation 测试每个 check。执行之前，应对生成 class/check string 设置文件、进程、credential 与 network 边界的 sandbox。

SFT 复用只能谨慎进行。由于默认 Hugging Face builder 混合不兼容 schema，用户必须显式选择兼容 raw 或 transformed trajectory file；还应复现论文的 format/completion/length filter，区分 conversation 与 non-conversation stop rule，保留 teacher identity Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507，并避免把这些 row 标为 terminally verified。upstream right、lineage、dropped failure 与 data-specific license scope 仍需审查。

RLVR 研究可以从 2,550 条带 verifier 的 RL scenario 与公开 runtime/training scaffold 开始。可执行研究包括：对每个 Python predicate 做 property-based test、盲评 checklist coverage、测试 alternate-valid state、搜索 adversarial shortcut、探测 reward hacking、比较 warning-versus-pass sensitivity，并进行 cross-version replay。这是研究起点，不是对论文 RL run 的 drop-in reproduction，因为 online rollout、reward trace、确切 endpoint、dependency 与 run manifest 都缺失。

construction recipe 可用于受控 ablation：固定 task count 改变 environment count，或固定 environment 改变 scenario 与 rollout count；比较 strict-pass selection 与 pass-or-warning；发布 rejected program 与 trajectory；测量 gain 究竟来自 environment diversity、teacher behavior、verifier coverage 还是 data volume。Qwen3-1.7B 在 Tau-Bench 的下降应保留为必要 negative control。

复用等级是 mixed 且有条件。证据支持 SFT、RLVR 与 agent training 这些预期用途，但尚未证明发布可安全、无限制或 drop-in reproducible 地用于训练。固定 revision 后可做 environment/scenario inspection；SFT 需要 schema 选择和 rights/quality review；准确 RL 复现则因缺少 rollout/replay、verifier、security、dependency 与 version 证据而受阻。benchmark gain 不能覆盖这些边界。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with the four released objects: 191 executable environments, 4,684 SFT scenarios without checks, 2,550 RL scenarios with checks, and 9,022 claimed SFT trajectories. No RL rollout corpus is public.
  • Read the feedback chain as generated terminal checklist -> Python Boolean checks -> passed fraction in [0,1]. Task Completed, ###STOP###, or an action limit terminates an episode but does not itself establish success.
  • Inspect the selector code with the paper: 191 of 266 candidates survive 100 checking rounds at not-fail >= 0.85, where warning is counted with pass; 75 rejected programs and raw votes are unavailable.
  • Treat SFT and RL evidence differently: SFT rows are filtered for syntax/completion/length and LLM-judged feasibility without terminal reward; RL uses online 64 x 8 rollouts per step, but those trajectories and rewards are not released.
  • Before reuse, separate the incompatible HF trajectory schemas, sandbox Python exec, pin commit 87e6673 and all four HF revisions, and obtain a manifest for dependencies, prompts, endpoints, seeds, failures, rights, and replay.

• 先区分四种公开对象：191 个 executable environment、4,684 条无 check 的 SFT scenario、2,550 条带 check 的 RL scenario，以及声称共 9,022 条的 SFT trajectory。没有公开 RL rollout corpus。
  • feedback chain 应读作 generated terminal checklist -> Python Boolean check -> [0,1] 范围的通过比例。Task Completed、###STOP### 或 action limit 会结束 episode，但本身不证明成功。
  • 应把 selector code 与论文对照：266 个 candidate 中有 191 个在 100 轮检查、not-fail >= 0.85 时保留，其中 warning 与 pass 合并计算；75 个 rejected program 和 raw vote 不可得。
  • SFT 与 RL 证据必须区别处理：SFT row 只按 syntax/completion/length 和 LLM-judged feasibility 筛选，没有 terminal reward；RL 每 step online 采样 64 x 8 条 rollout，但这些 trajectory 与 reward 没有发布。
  • 复用前应拆分不兼容 HF trajectory schema，sandbox Python exec，固定 commit 87e6673 与四个 HF revision，并补充覆盖 dependency、prompt、endpoint、seed、failure、right 和 replay 的 manifest。
